26.1.2.0.2.1: Fix: the anvil no longer lets a soulbound tool sacrifice smuggle Soulbound onto non-infused gear.
26.1.2.0.2.0: Enderium infusion + Soulbound: gear that comes back from death.
26.1.2.0.1.0: Enderium ore, raw enderium, ingots, End worldgen.
26.1.2.0.3.0: The Enderium Tier: enderium gear is now real items above netherite; upgrade netherite gear at the smithing table. Soulbound is enderium-exclusive (0.2.x infusion markers and trims no longer qualify).
26.1.2.0.4.0: The Void Gives Back: enderium items you drop return from the void, the despawn timer, and fire; ender pearls cost nothing in enderium armor. Also fixes two shipped soulbound bugs (death-screen delivery wipe, store save crash).
26.1.2.0.4.1: The void now tells you why it kept your gear: dying with unbound enderium prints the covenant hint. Gameplay unchanged: thrown/lost enderium returns, died-with needs Soulbound.
26.1.2.0.5.0: Set in Stone: the End learns masonry. Polished end stone + tile families, the Mourner Relief, Blocks of Enderium (beacon base) and Raw Enderium, and the Enderium Lantern with rising teal embers. Full stonecutter support.
26.1.2.0.6.0: Mourning Blooms: deaths in the End sprout flowers; blooms craft Void Petals; petal + bottle = Draught of Return (drink, wander 90s, snap back, End-only). Bloom density and draught duration are first guesses: tell us what feels wrong.
26.1.2.0.7.0: The Cenotaphs: ruined memorials across the outer End holding named lost-traveler gear (worn, often Soulbound, and the covenant now honors the mark on any metal), Void Petals, raw enderium, and the first renewable Enderium Upgrade Templates. Ground-checked placement: no floating ruins. Spacing and loot rates are first guesses: argue with us.
26.1.2.1.0.0: The Way Home, the 1.0 candidate: the Homeward Pearl carries you from anywhere to your own respawn (consumed, 5s cooldown, never rolls the credits); enderium ore and blocks glimmer with reverse-portal motes and a rare hum; the advancement tab completes its eight-node arc, Buried Light through The Way Home. One week of alpha soak, then the full release.
26.1.2.1.0.1: JEI integration: every recipe already showed, and now the covenant explains itself. Info pages for the ore, the materials, the template, blooms, petals, the draught, the pearl, and the gear. Optional: nothing changes without JEI installed.
